d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: The loss of braking power when the brakes are hot, so that the pedal goes soft.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: The loss of braking power when the brakes are hot, so that the pedal goes soft.

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: ブレーキが過熱-trainingsによって制動力を失い、ペダルが柔らかくなる現象。长時間の下り坂などで起こりやすい。
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: ブレーキが熱くなって制動力が落ち、ペダルが柔らかくなる現象。

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: 브레이크가 뜨거워지면 제동력이 감소하여 페달이 부드러워지는 현상. 장거리 하강이나 반복 제동 뒤에 나타날 수 있다.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: 브레이크가 뜨거워지면 제동력이 줄어 페달이 부드러워지는 현상.

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: Redução da força de frenagem quando os freios estão quentes, fazendo com que o pedal pareça mais leve. É comum após uso intenso, como em descidas longas.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: Perda da capacidade de frenagem quando os freios estão quentes e o pedal fica mole.

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: Kehilangan daya rem ketika rem terlalu panas sehingga pedal rem terasa empuk. Kondisi ini berbeda dari rem yang_NORMAL pada awal gunakan.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: Kehilangan daya rem ketika rem panas sehingga pedal terasa empuk.

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: อาการที่เบรกมีความร้อนสูงจนเสียแรงเบรก ทำให้แป้นเบรกนุ่มและระยะเบรกยาวขึ้น
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: เบรกร้อนจนแรงเบรกลดลงและแป้นเบรกนุ่มขึ้น

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.definition: Frenler aşırı ısındığında frenleme gücünün azalması ve fren pedalının yumuşamasıdır. Bu durumda aracı durdurmak zorlaşır.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.gloss: Frenler aşırı ısındığında fren gücünün azalması ve pedalın yumuşaması.

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.translation: Uzun yokuştan sonra frenler ısındı, fren gücü azaldı ve pedal yumuşadı.
หลังลงทางลาดยาวเป็นเวลานาน เบรกจึงร้อนจนแรงเบรกลดลงและแป้นเบรกรู้สึกนุ่ม
Setelah turun panjang, remnya kehilangan daya dan pedal terasa lemah.
Depois da longa descida, os freios perderam força e o pedal ficou mole.
오르막길을 오래 내려오니 브레이크가 과열되어 제동력이 줄었다.
長い坂を下ったあとブレーキの力が落ち、ペダルが弱く感じるようになった。

d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.text: After the long descent the brakes faded and the pedal felt weak.
d22e7467a13cfcc1dc34f89fb8878408149c6942.translation: Sau một đoạn đường đổ dốc dài, phanh bị suy giảm hiệu quả và bàn đạp phanh cảm thấy yếu.

d2369e7997d5f37d0917a423c56064cf028672a0.definition: Tốc độ thay đổi của vận tốc theo thời gian; đơn vị SI là m/s².
The rate of change of velocity with time.

d2369e7997d5f37d0917a423c56064cf028672a0.text: A car that speeds up from 0 to 100 km/h in 10 s has an acceleration of 2.78 m/s².
d2369e7997d5f37d0917a423c56064cf028672a0.translation: Một chiếc xe tăng tốc từ 0 lên 100 km/h trong 10 s có gia tốc 2,78 m/s².

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: A machine with two wheels that you push with your feet. A good bicycle makes your legs feel like they have a strong friend.
d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.gloss: A machine with two wheels that you push with your feet. A good bicycle makes your legs feel like they have a strong friend.

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: ペダルを足で漕いで進む、二つの車輪Grayのある乗り物。通勤や運動、レジャーなどに使われます。
d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.gloss: 足で漕いで進む、二つの車輪の乗り物。

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: pedal과 손잡이로 움직이는 두 바퀴짜리 탈것으로, 발로 페달을 밟아 나갑니다.
d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.gloss: 바퀴가 두 개 있어 발로 밀어 나가는 탈것입니다.

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: Meio de transporte com duas rodas, guidado pelos pés por meio do pedal.
d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.gloss: Veículo de duas rodas que se desloca quando se pedala.

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: Kendaraan dengan dua roda yang dijalankan dengan mengayuh kaki. Jangan tertukar dengan sepeda motor, yang digerakkan oleh mesin.
d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.gloss: Alat dengan dua roda yang digerakkan dengan mengayuh kaki.

d29af8a2e160dd867fe45a75f70bf805b1b6c1cf.definition: ยานพาหนะที่มีล้อสองล้อและขับเคลื่อนด้วยการปั่นเท้า ไม่ใช่จักรยานยนต์ที่ใช้เครื่องยนต์
İki tekerleği ve pedalı olan, ayakla hareket ettirilen araç. Ulaşım için veya eğlence amacıyla kullanılır.
